cleanup.stale_items_from_earlier_court_runs: counted and deleted after this probe; see README

conclusions: first creation and later reads by the same build are reproducible without UI on an unlocked login keychain
any rebuild (new cdhash) orphans unattended access to every existing sealed profile under that root: -25293 with interaction disabled, fail closed
the no-UI mode is therefore a fail-closed guarantee, not an unattended-deployment guarantee: a locked keychain, a different user session, or a rebuilt or re-signed binary all refuse

an unattended deployment would need a stable designated requirement (a signing identity whose requirement is not a per-build cdhash) or a one-time interactive grant outside the host; both are open P6 work and not claimed
